entities.summary: The Battle of Mirăslău, or Battle of Miriszló, took place on September 18, 1600, near Miriszló, Transylvania, between the Wallachian troops led by Michael the Brave supported by ethnic Hungarian Szeklers and the troops of Austrian general Giorgio Basta supported by the Hungarian nobility of Transylvania.
